Sovollar: 1. Are you a happy person?
Sovollar (UZ): Siz baxtli odammisiz?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, I consider myself a happy person because I try to appreciate the good things in my life. I enjoy spending time with my family and friends. Of course, I have bad days, but I usually try to stay positive.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, men o‘zimni baxtli inson deb hisoblayman, chunki hayotimdagi yaxshi narsalarni qadrlashga harakat qilaman. Oilam va do‘stlarim bilan vaqt o‘tkazish menga yoqadi. Albatta, yomon kunlarim ham bo‘ladi, lekin odatda ijobiy bo‘lishga harakat qilaman.

Sovollar: 2. When do you feel unhappy?
Sovollar (UZ): Qachon o‘zingizni baxtsiz his qilasiz?
FullAnswer_EN: I usually feel unhappy when I have too many problems or when something does not go as planned. I also feel bad when I argue with someone close to me. However, I try to solve my problems instead of thinking about them for too long.
FullAnswer_UZ: Odatda juda ko‘p muammolarim bo‘lsa yoki ishlar rejalashtirganimdek ketmasa, o‘zimni baxtsiz his qilaman. Yaqin insonim bilan janjallashib qolsam ham o‘zimni yomon his qilaman. Biroq muammolar haqida uzoq o‘ylashdan ko‘ra, ularni hal qilishga harakat qilaman.

Sovollar: 3. What makes you happy?
Sovollar (UZ): Sizni nima baxtli qiladi?
FullAnswer_EN: Spending time with people I love makes me happy. I also feel good when I achieve something that I have worked hard for. Simple things like listening to music or having a relaxing evening can also improve my mood.
FullAnswer_UZ: Men sevgan insonlarim bilan vaqt o‘tkazish meni baxtli qiladi. Ko‘p mehnat qilgan narsamga erishsam ham o‘zimni yaxshi his qilaman. Musiqa tinglash yoki tinch oqshom o‘tkazish kabi oddiy narsalar ham kayfiyatimni ko‘taradi.

Sovollar: 4. Are you introvert or extravert?
Sovollar (UZ): Siz introvertmisiz yoki ekstravert?
FullAnswer_EN: I think I am more of an introvert, although I can be social when I feel comfortable. I enjoy spending time alone and thinking about my plans. However, I also like talking to close friends and meeting new people.
FullAnswer_UZ: Menimcha, men ko‘proq introvertman, garchi o‘zimni qulay his qilganimda odamlar bilan muloqot qila olsam ham. Yolg‘iz vaqt o‘tkazish va rejalarim haqida o‘ylash menga yoqadi. Shu bilan birga, yaqin do‘stlarim bilan gaplashishni va yangi odamlar bilan tanishishni ham yaxshi ko‘raman.

Sovollar: 1. Are kids patient nowadays? What things can’t they wait for?
Sovollar (UZ): Hozirgi kunda bolalar sabrlimi? Ular qaysi narsalarni kuta olmaydilar?
FullAnswer_EN: I don't think many children are very patient nowadays because they are used to getting things quickly. For example, they often want new toys, games, or videos immediately. Technology has made waiting more difficult for them.
FullAnswer_UZ: Menimcha, hozirgi kunda ko‘p bolalar juda sabrli emas, chunki ular narsalarni tez olishga o‘rganib qolishgan. Masalan, ular yangi o‘yinchoq, o‘yin yoki videoni darhol xohlashadi. Texnologiya ular uchun kutishni qiyinlashtirdi.

Sovollar: 2. Should parents buy their kids whatever they want?
Sovollar (UZ): Ota-onalar farzandlariga ular xohlagan hamma narsani olib berishlari kerakmi?
FullAnswer_EN: No, I don't think parents should buy everything their children want. Children need to understand that money and things have value. Sometimes saying no can teach them to be more responsible and patient.
FullAnswer_UZ: Yo‘q, menimcha, ota-onalar farzandlari xohlagan hamma narsani olib bermasliklari kerak. Bolalar pul va narsalarning qadrini tushunishlari kerak. Ba’zan yo‘q deyish ularga mas’uliyatli va sabrli bo‘lishni o‘rgatishi mumkin.

Sovollar: 3. Do parents need to teach their children to be patient?
Sovollar (UZ): Ota-onalar farzandlariga sabrli bo‘lishni o‘rgatishlari kerakmi?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, definitely, because patience is an important skill in life. Children need to learn that good things sometimes take time. Parents can teach patience by asking their children to wait and complete tasks step by step.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, albatta, chunki sabr hayotdagi muhim ko‘nikmalardan biridir. Bolalar yaxshi narsalarga ba’zan vaqt kerakligini o‘rganishlari lozim. Ota-onalar farzandlaridan kutishni va vazifalarni bosqichma-bosqich bajarishni so‘rab, sabrni o‘rgatishlari mumkin.

Sovollar: 4. How do you manage to resist your temptation?
Sovollar (UZ): Vasvasalaringizga qanday qarshi turasiz?
FullAnswer_EN: I usually remind myself of my goals when I feel tempted to do something unnecessary. I try to think about the long-term results instead of my immediate feelings. Keeping myself busy also helps me avoid unnecessary temptations.
FullAnswer_UZ: Keraksiz biror narsa qilish istagi paydo bo‘lsa, odatda o‘z maqsadlarimni eslayman. Men hozirgi his-tuyg‘ularimdan ko‘ra uzoq muddatli natijalar haqida o‘ylashga harakat qilaman. O‘zimni band qilish ham keraksiz vasvasalardan qochishga yordam beradi.

Sovollar: 1. Are you interested in doing business?
Sovollar (UZ): Siz biznes bilan shug‘ullanishga qiziqasizmi?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, I am interested in business because it can give people independence and new opportunities. I would like to learn how businesses work and how successful companies grow. I think business also teaches useful skills such as communication and problem-solving.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, men biznesga qiziqaman, chunki u odamlarga mustaqillik va yangi imkoniyatlar berishi mumkin. Biznes qanday ishlashi va muvaffaqiyatli kompaniyalar qanday rivojlanishini o‘rganishni xohlardim. Menimcha, biznes muloqot va muammolarni hal qilish kabi foydali ko‘nikmalarni ham o‘rgatadi.

Sovollar: 2. Is it easy to set up a business in Uzbekistan?
Sovollar (UZ): O‘zbekistonda biznes boshlash osonmi?
FullAnswer_EN: I think starting a business in Uzbekistan is possible, but it is not always easy. People need money, a good plan, and knowledge about the market and laws. However, modern technology and online services have made some parts of the process easier.
FullAnswer_UZ: Menimcha, O‘zbekistonda biznes boshlash mumkin, lekin bu har doim ham oson emas. Odamlarga pul, yaxshi reja va bozor hamda qonunlar haqida bilim kerak. Biroq zamonaviy texnologiyalar va onlayn xizmatlar jarayonning ayrim qismlarini osonlashtirdi.

Sovollar: 3. Do you have any business people in your family?
Sovollar (UZ): Oilangizda biznes bilan shug‘ullanuvchi odamlar bormi?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, there are some people in my family who have experience in business. I have learned from them that running a business requires patience and responsibility. Their experience has made me more interested in entrepreneurship.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, oilamda biznesda tajribaga ega bo‘lgan insonlar bor. Ulardan biznes yuritish sabr va mas’uliyat talab qilishini o‘rganganman. Ularning tajribasi menda tadbirkorlikka qiziqishni yanada oshirdi.

Sovollar: 4. What successful companies do you know?
Sovollar (UZ): Qaysi muvaffaqiyatli kompaniyalarni bilasiz?
FullAnswer_EN: I know companies such as Apple, Microsoft, Google, and Amazon. They became successful by creating useful products and adapting to changes in technology. I think their success also comes from strong brands and good management.
FullAnswer_UZ: Men Apple, Microsoft, Google va Amazon kabi kompaniyalarni bilaman. Ular foydali mahsulotlar yaratish va texnologiyadagi o‘zgarishlarga moslashish orqali muvaffaqiyatga erishgan. Menimcha, ularning muvaffaqiyatiga kuchli brend va yaxshi boshqaruv ham sabab bo‘lgan.

Sovollar: 1. If you wanted to set up a business, what business would you start?
Sovollar (UZ): Agar biznes boshlamoqchi bo‘lsangiz, qanday biznes boshlardingiz?
FullAnswer_EN: If I started a business, I would probably create an online education company. I would provide affordable courses for people who want to improve their English and professional skills. I think this type of business could be useful because many people want to learn online.
FullAnswer_UZ: Agar biznes boshlasam, ehtimol onlayn ta’lim kompaniyasini tashkil qilardim. Ingliz tili va kasbiy ko‘nikmalarini rivojlantirmoqchi bo‘lganlar uchun hamyonbop kurslar taklif qilardim. Menimcha, bunday biznes foydali bo‘lishi mumkin, chunki ko‘p odamlar onlayn o‘qishni xohlashadi.

Sovollar: 2. What are the challenges of starting a business?
Sovollar (UZ): Biznes boshlashda qanday qiyinchiliklar mavjud?
FullAnswer_EN: One of the biggest challenges is finding enough money to start the business. Another problem is competition because there may already be many similar companies. Business owners also need to make good decisions and accept the possibility of failure.
FullAnswer_UZ: Eng katta qiyinchiliklardan biri biznesni boshlash uchun yetarli pul topishdir. Yana bir muammo raqobat, chunki bozorda shunga o‘xshash ko‘plab kompaniyalar bo‘lishi mumkin. Biznes egalari yaxshi qarorlar qabul qilishlari va muvaffaqiyatsizlik ehtimolini ham qabul qilishlari kerak.

Sovollar: 3. How can you advertise your products or service?
Sovollar (UZ): Mahsulot yoki xizmatingizni qanday reklama qilishingiz mumkin?
FullAnswer_EN: I would mainly use social media because it is relatively cheap and can reach many people. I would create useful and interesting content to attract potential customers. I would also use recommendations and special offers to build a strong customer base.
FullAnswer_UZ: Men asosan ijtimoiy tarmoqlardan foydalanardim, chunki ular nisbatan arzon va ko‘p odamlarga yetib borish imkonini beradi. Potensial mijozlarni jalb qilish uchun foydali va qiziqarli kontent yaratardim. Kuchli mijozlar bazasini yaratish uchun tavsiyalar va maxsus takliflardan ham foydalanardim.

Sovollar: 4. If you needed some financial support, how would you attract some investors?
Sovollar (UZ): Agar moliyaviy yordam kerak bo‘lsa, investorlarni qanday jalb qilardingiz?
FullAnswer_EN: First, I would create a clear business plan and explain how the business could make a profit. I would show investors the market, potential customers, and my plans for growth. I would also try to show confidence and explain why my idea is different from competitors.
FullAnswer_UZ: Avvalo, aniq biznes-reja tuzib, biznes qanday foyda keltirishi mumkinligini tushuntirardim. Investorlar uchun bozor, potensial mijozlar va rivojlanish rejalarimni ko‘rsatardim. Shuningdek, o‘zimga bo‘lgan ishonchimni ko‘rsatib, g‘oyam raqobatchilardan nimasi bilan farq qilishini tushuntirardim.

Sovollar: 1. Do you like competitions?
Sovollar (UZ): Musobaqalarni yoqtirasizmi?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, I like competitions because they motivate me to work harder. I enjoy competing with others when the competition is friendly. It can also help me understand my strengths and weaknesses.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, men musobaqalarni yoqtiraman, chunki ular meni ko‘proq harakat qilishga undaydi. Raqobat do‘stona bo‘lsa, boshqalar bilan bellashish menga yoqadi. Bu menga kuchli va zaif tomonlarimni tushunishga ham yordam beradi.

Sovollar: 2. Have you ever taken part in a competition?
Sovollar (UZ): Hech qachon musobaqada qatnashganmisiz?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, I have taken part in several competitions at school and university. Some of them were difficult, but they gave me useful experience. Even when I did not win, I learned something from the experience.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, maktab va universitetda bir nechta musobaqalarda qatnashganman. Ularning ayrimlari qiyin bo‘lgan, lekin menga foydali tajriba bergan. Hatto g‘alaba qozonmagan paytlarimda ham bu tajribadan nimanidir o‘rganganman.

Sovollar: 3. Which is more important: competition or cooperation?
Sovollar (UZ): Qaysi biri muhimroq: raqobatmi yoki hamkorlikmi?
FullAnswer_EN: I think cooperation is more important because people can achieve bigger goals by working together. Competition is also useful because it encourages people to improve. In my opinion, the best situation is to cooperate while still trying to improve yourself.
FullAnswer_UZ: Menimcha, hamkorlik muhimroq, chunki odamlar birgalikda ishlash orqali kattaroq maqsadlarga erisha oladilar. Raqobat ham foydali, chunki u odamlarni rivojlanishga undaydi. Menimcha, eng yaxshi yo‘l hamkorlik qilish va shu bilan birga o‘z ustingda ishlashdir.

Sovollar: 4. Do you like competitive sports?
Sovollar (UZ): Raqobatli sport turlarini yoqtirasizmi?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, I enjoy watching and sometimes playing competitive sports. They are exciting because the result is not always predictable. I especially like sports where teamwork and strategy are important.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, men raqobatli sport turlarini tomosha qilishni va ba’zan o‘ynashni yoqtiraman. Ular qiziqarli, chunki natijani har doim ham oldindan bilib bo‘lmaydi. Ayniqsa, jamoaviy ish va strategiya muhim bo‘lgan sport turlarini yoqtiraman.

Sovollar: 1. What competitive sports do you know?
Sovollar (UZ): Qanday raqobatli sport turlarini bilasiz?
FullAnswer_EN: There are many competitive sports, such as football, basketball, tennis, boxing, and athletics. Some of them are individual sports, while others require a team. Each sport has different rules and requires different skills.
FullAnswer_UZ: Futbol, basketbol, tennis, boks va yengil atletika kabi ko‘plab raqobatli sport turlari mavjud. Ularning ayrimlari individual sport bo‘lsa, boshqalari jamoaviy mehnatni talab qiladi. Har bir sportning o‘z qoidalari va turli ko‘nikmalari mavjud.

Sovollar: 2. Should children do competitive sports at school?
Sovollar (UZ): Bolalar maktabda raqobatli sport turlari bilan shug‘ullanishlari kerakmi?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, I think children should take part in competitive sports at school. It can teach them teamwork, discipline, and how to deal with both success and failure. However, teachers should make sure that the competition is healthy and enjoyable.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, menimcha, bolalar maktabda raqobatli sport turlari bilan shug‘ullanishlari kerak. Bu ularga jamoada ishlash, intizom va g‘alaba hamda mag‘lubiyatni qabul qilishni o‘rgatadi. Biroq o‘qituvchilar musobaqa sog‘lom va qiziqarli bo‘lishini ta’minlashlari kerak.

Sovollar: 3. What are the advantages of competitive sports?
Sovollar (UZ): Raqobatli sportning qanday afzalliklari bor?
FullAnswer_EN: Competitive sports can improve physical health and teach people to work hard. They also develop discipline, confidence, and teamwork. Another advantage is that people learn how to deal with pressure.
FullAnswer_UZ: Raqobatli sport jismoniy salomatlikni yaxshilashi va odamlarni qattiq mehnat qilishga o‘rgatishi mumkin. Ular intizom, o‘ziga ishonch va jamoada ishlash ko‘nikmalarini ham rivojlantiradi. Yana bir afzalligi shundaki, odamlar bosim bilan kurashishni o‘rganadilar.

Sovollar: 4. What are the disadvantages of competitive sports?
Sovollar (UZ): Raqobatli sportning qanday kamchiliklari bor?
FullAnswer_EN: One disadvantage is that some people become too focused on winning. This can create stress and make sports less enjoyable. There is also a risk of injuries, especially when athletes train too hard.
FullAnswer_UZ: Kamchiliklardan biri shundaki, ba’zi odamlar faqat g‘alaba qozonishga juda ko‘p e’tibor berishadi. Bu stress keltirib chiqarishi va sportni kamroq qiziqarli qilishi mumkin. Ayniqsa, sportchilar haddan tashqari ko‘p mashq qilganda jarohatlanish xavfi ham mavjud.

Sovollar: 1. What do you do in your free time?
Sovollar (UZ): Bo‘sh vaqtingizda nima qilasiz?
FullAnswer_EN: In my free time, I usually watch films, listen to music, or meet my friends. I also spend some time learning new things online. When I am tired, I prefer simply relaxing at home.
FullAnswer_UZ: Bo‘sh vaqtimda odatda filmlar tomosha qilaman, musiqa tinglayman yoki do‘stlarim bilan uchrashaman. Shuningdek, internet orqali yangi narsalarni o‘rganishga ham vaqt ajrataman. Charchaganimda esa uyda shunchaki dam olishni afzal ko‘raman.

Sovollar: 2. Have you ever participated in any sport competitions?
Sovollar (UZ): Hech qachon sport musobaqalarida qatnashganmisiz?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, I have participated in a few sports competitions. They were not professional competitions, but they were still exciting and challenging. I learned that preparation and teamwork are very important.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, bir nechta sport musobaqalarida qatnashganman. Ular professional musobaqalar emas edi, lekin baribir qiziqarli va qiyin bo‘lgan. Men tayyorgarlik va jamoaviy ish juda muhimligini tushundim.

Sovollar: 3. Do you like travelling across your country?
Sovollar (UZ): Mamlakatingiz bo‘ylab sayohat qilishni yoqtirasizmi?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, I really enjoy travelling around my country because there are many interesting places to visit. I like seeing different landscapes and learning about local culture. Travelling also helps me relax and forget about my daily routine.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, mamlakatim bo‘ylab sayohat qilishni juda yoqtiraman, chunki tashrif buyurishga arziydigan ko‘plab qiziqarli joylar bor. Turli manzaralarni ko‘rish va mahalliy madaniyat haqida bilish menga yoqadi. Sayohat qilish menga dam olish va kundalik hayotimni bir muddat unutishga yordam beradi.

Sovollar: 4. Do you prefer to spend time indoors or outdoors?
Sovollar (UZ): Vaqtingizni uyda yoki tashqarida o‘tkazishni afzal ko‘rasizmi?
FullAnswer_EN: I prefer spending time outdoors because I feel more energetic when I am outside. I enjoy walking, travelling, and meeting friends in different places. However, I also like staying indoors when I need to rest.
FullAnswer_UZ: Men vaqtimni tashqarida o‘tkazishni afzal ko‘raman, chunki tashqarida bo‘lganimda o‘zimni faolroq his qilaman. Sayr qilish, sayohat qilish va turli joylarda do‘stlarim bilan uchrashishni yoqtiraman. Biroq dam olishim kerak bo‘lsa, uyda qolishni ham yaxshi ko‘raman.

Sovollar: 1. Describe your dream job.
Sovollar (UZ): Orzuingizdagi kasbni tasvirlab bering.
FullAnswer_EN: My dream job would be a career where I can use my creativity and work with interesting people. I would like to have a good salary, but a friendly working environment is also important to me. Most importantly, I want to enjoy my work and continue learning.
FullAnswer_UZ: Mening orzuimdagi ish ijodkorligimdan foydalanish va qiziqarli insonlar bilan ishlash imkonini beradigan kasb bo‘lardi. Yaxshi maosh men uchun muhim, lekin do‘stona ish muhiti ham katta ahamiyatga ega. Eng muhimi, ishimdan zavq olish va o‘rganishda davom etishni xohlayman.

Sovollar: 2. What job will be popular in the future?
Sovollar (UZ): Kelajakda qaysi kasblar mashhur bo‘ladi?
FullAnswer_EN: I think technology-related jobs will become even more popular in the future. For example, software developers, data analysts, and artificial intelligence specialists may be in high demand. At the same time, people with strong communication and creative skills will also be needed.
FullAnswer_UZ: Menimcha, kelajakda texnologiya bilan bog‘liq kasblar yanada mashhur bo‘ladi. Masalan, dasturchilar, ma’lumotlar tahlilchilari va sun’iy intellekt mutaxassislariga talab yuqori bo‘lishi mumkin. Shu bilan birga, kuchli muloqot va ijodiy ko‘nikmalarga ega insonlar ham kerak bo‘ladi.

Sovollar: 3. Explain profession that is getting popular in your country now.
Sovollar (UZ): Hozir mamlakatingizda ommalashib borayotgan kasbni tushuntiring.
FullAnswer_EN: One profession that is becoming popular in Uzbekistan is software development. Many young people are learning programming because they can work for international companies from their home country. It is attractive because it can offer good career opportunities and flexible working conditions.
FullAnswer_UZ: O‘zbekistonda ommalashib borayotgan kasblardan biri dasturchilikdir. Ko‘plab yoshlar dasturlashni o‘rganmoqda, chunki ular o‘z mamlakatidan turib xalqaro kompaniyalarda ishlashlari mumkin. Bu kasb yaxshi karyera imkoniyatlari va moslashuvchan ish sharoitlarini taklif qilishi bilan jozibali.

Sovollar: 4. How will technology help people to do business that is more successful?
Sovollar (UZ): Texnologiya odamlarga biznesni yanada muvaffaqiyatli yuritishda qanday yordam beradi?
FullAnswer_EN: Technology helps businesses communicate with customers quickly and sell products online. Companies can also use data to understand what customers want. As a result, businesses can save time, reduce costs, and make better decisions.
FullAnswer_UZ: Texnologiya bizneslarga mijozlar bilan tez muloqot qilish va mahsulotlarni onlayn sotishga yordam beradi. Kompaniyalar mijozlar nimani xohlashini tushunish uchun ma’lumotlardan ham foydalanishlari mumkin. Natijada bizneslar vaqtni tejashi, xarajatlarni kamaytirishi va yaxshiroq qarorlar qabul qilishi mumkin.

Sovollar: 1. Is it safe to live in your city?
Sovollar (UZ): Shaharingizda yashash xavfsizmi?
FullAnswer_EN: Yes, I think my city is generally a safe place to live. Most people can go to work, study, and travel around the city without serious problems. However, it is still important to be careful, especially at night.
FullAnswer_UZ: Ha, menimcha, mening shahrim umuman olganda yashash uchun xavfsiz joy. Ko‘pchilik odamlar jiddiy muammolarsiz ishga, o‘qishga va shahar bo‘ylab yurishlari mumkin. Biroq ayniqsa tunda ehtiyot bo‘lish baribir muhim.

Sovollar: 2. What types of crimes do you know?
Sovollar (UZ): Qanday jinoyat turlarini bilasiz?
FullAnswer_EN: There are many types of crime, such as theft, robbery, fraud, and cybercrime. Some crimes happen physically, while others happen online. I think people should understand basic safety rules to protect themselves.
FullAnswer_UZ: O‘g‘rilik, talonchilik, firibgarlik va kiberjinoyat kabi ko‘plab jinoyat turlari mavjud. Ba’zi jinoyatlar jismoniy tarzda, boshqalari esa internet orqali sodir bo‘ladi. Menimcha, odamlar o‘zlarini himoya qilish uchun asosiy xavfsizlik qoidalarini bilishlari kerak.

Sovollar: 3. Is the nightlife dangerous in your city?
Sovollar (UZ): Shaharingizdagi tungi hayot xavflimi?
FullAnswer_EN: I would not say that nightlife in my city is very dangerous. There are many places where people can spend time safely with friends. However, people should avoid isolated areas and be careful when travelling home late at night.
FullAnswer_UZ: Shahrimdagi tungi hayotni juda xavfli deb aytmagan bo‘lardim. Odamlar do‘stlari bilan xavfsiz vaqt o‘tkazishlari mumkin bo‘lgan ko‘plab joylar mavjud. Biroq odamlar kimsasiz joylardan qochishlari va kechasi uyga qaytayotganda ehtiyot bo‘lishlari kerak.

Sovollar: 4. Have you ever witnessed any type of crime?
Sovollar (UZ): Hech qachon biror jinoyatga guvoh bo‘lganmisiz?
FullAnswer_EN: I have never witnessed a very serious crime directly. However, I have seen small incidents such as people arguing or someone trying to steal something. In such situations, I think it is better to stay safe and contact the appropriate authorities.
FullAnswer_UZ: Men hech qachon juda jiddiy jinoyatga bevosita guvoh bo‘lmaganman. Biroq odamlarning janjallashgani yoki kimdir biror narsani o‘g‘irlashga urinayotganini ko‘rganman. Bunday vaziyatlarda xavfsizlikni saqlash va tegishli organlarga murojaat qilish yaxshiroq deb o‘ylayman.

Sovollar: 1. What would you do to decrease the crime rate if you worked as a police officer?
Sovollar (UZ): Agar politsiya xodimi bo‘lib ishlaganingizda, jinoyatchilik darajasini kamaytirish uchun nima qilardingiz?
FullAnswer_EN: I would focus on preventing crime instead of only reacting after crimes happen. I would support better street lighting, community programs, and cooperation between police and local residents. I would also make sure that young people have educational and social opportunities.
FullAnswer_UZ: Men jinoyat sodir bo‘lgandan keyin javob berishdan ko‘ra, jinoyatlarning oldini olishga e’tibor qaratardim. Ko‘chalarni yaxshiroq yoritish, jamoat dasturlari va politsiya hamda mahalliy aholi o‘rtasidagi hamkorlikni qo‘llab-quvvatlardim. Yoshlar uchun ta’lim va ijtimoiy imkoniyatlar bo‘lishini ham ta’minlashga harakat qilardim.

Sovollar: 2. Why do you think crime rates are higher in cities?
Sovollar (UZ): Nima uchun shaharlarda jinoyatchilik darajasi yuqoriroq deb o‘ylaysiz?
FullAnswer_EN: Cities have large populations, so there are simply more people and more opportunities for crime. Some cities also have problems such as unemployment, poverty, and overcrowding. These social problems can sometimes increase criminal activity.
FullAnswer_UZ: Shaharlarda aholi juda ko‘p bo‘ladi, shuning uchun odamlar va jinoyat sodir bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lgan imkoniyatlar ham ko‘proq. Ayrim shaharlarda ishsizlik, qashshoqlik va aholining haddan tashqari zichligi kabi muammolar ham mavjud. Bunday ijtimoiy muammolar ba’zan jinoyatchilikni oshirishi mumkin.

Sovollar: 3. What is cybercrime?
Sovollar (UZ): Kiberjinoyat nima?
FullAnswer_EN: Cybercrime is a crime that involves computers, phones, or the internet. For example, criminals may steal personal information, hack accounts, or use fake websites to take people's money. People should use strong passwords and be careful with suspicious messages.

Sovollar (UZ): Kundalik hayotingizda texnologiyadan qanday foydalanasiz?
FullAnswer_EN: I use technology for studying, working, communicating, and entertainment. My smartphone and computer are especially important because I use them almost every day. They help me save time and stay organized.
FullAnswer_UZ: Men texnologiyadan o‘qish, ishlash, muloqot va ko‘ngil ochish uchun foydalanaman. Smartfonim va kompyuterim ayniqsa muhim, chunki ulardan deyarli har kuni foydalanaman. Ular vaqtimni tejash va tartibli bo‘lishimga yordam beradi.

Sovollar: 2. What are the advantages of using smart devices?
Sovollar (UZ): Aqlli qurilmalardan foydalanishning qanday afzalliklari bor?
FullAnswer_EN: Smart devices are convenient because they allow us to do many things in one place. We can communicate, study, work, make payments, and find information using one device. They can save a lot of time in our daily lives.
FullAnswer_UZ: Aqlli qurilmalar qulay, chunki ular bir joyning o‘zida ko‘plab ishlarni bajarish imkonini beradi. Biz bitta qurilma orqali muloqot qilishimiz, o‘qishimiz, ishlashimiz, to‘lov qilishimiz va ma’lumot topishimiz mumkin. Ular kundalik hayotimizda ko‘p vaqtni tejashi mumkin.

Sovollar: 3. Can you imagine your life without technology?
Sovollar (UZ): Hayotingizni texnologiyasiz tasavvur qila olasizmi?
FullAnswer_EN: It would be very difficult for me to imagine my life without technology. I use it for education, communication, work, and many everyday tasks. I could live without some devices, but living completely without modern technology would be extremely difficult.
FullAnswer_UZ: Hayotimni texnologiyasiz tasavvur qilish men uchun juda qiyin. Men undan ta’lim, muloqot, ish va ko‘plab kundalik vazifalar uchun foydalanaman. Ayrim qurilmalarsiz yashashim mumkin, lekin zamonaviy texnologiyalarsiz to‘liq yashash juda qiyin bo‘lardi.

Sovollar: 4. How do you stay safe online?
Sovollar (UZ): Internetda o‘zingizni qanday xavfsiz saqlaysiz?
FullAnswer_EN: I use strong and different passwords for my important accounts. I also avoid clicking on suspicious links or sharing personal information with unknown people. In addition, I try to keep my devices and apps updated.
FullAnswer_UZ: Muhim akkauntlarim uchun kuchli va turli xil parollardan foydalanaman. Shuningdek, shubhali havolalarni bosmaslikka yoki notanish odamlarga shaxsiy ma’lumotlarimni bermaslikka harakat qilaman. Bundan tashqari, qurilmalarim va ilovalarimni yangilab turaman.
